parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: LogRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where logs are stored.

> You can call [DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~) to query the available log storage regions.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service project.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
